createBotTutorialPage.title: LINE Bot Creation Tutorial
createBotTutorialPage.step1Description: Go to LINE Developer and click Console
createBotTutorialPage.step2Description: Click 'Create a new channel' to create a new channel
createBotTutorialPage.step4Description: Complete the official account settings and go to the management page
createBotTutorialPage.step5Description: Go to settings, click Messaging API, and enable the Messaging API
createBotTutorialPage.step6Description: Copy the Channel ID and Channel Secret, which will be needed when adding a LINE Bot
createBotTutorialPage.step7Description: Return to LINE Developer, enter Messaging API, and obtain the Channel Access Token, which will be needed when adding a LINE Bot
createBotTutorialPage.step8Description: Copy the Webhook URL provided by EasyBot and paste it into the Webhook URL field
createBotTutorialPage.step9Description: Go to Response Settings, enable the Webhook, and disable both the greeting message for new friends and the auto-reply message
createBotTutorialPage.backToBotPage: Return to the Bot List page

feature.faqDescription: The FAQ module integrates AI's RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) system, allowing real-time retrieval of relevant answers from the database and providing accurate and natural responses through generative technology. Whether it's frequently asked questions or specialized knowledge, this module effortlessly handles it and ensures that users receive satisfactory answers.
feature.ecommDescription: The e-commerce module uses AI-driven data analytics to help you track customer behavior, predict sales trends, and automatically generate customer feedback reports. This enables merchants to manage inventory effectively, improve conversion rates, and provide a personalized shopping experience.
feature.reservationDescription: The Reservation Module simplifies the management of various bookings and schedules. From the customer's perspective, the booking process is quick and straightforward, with notification support ensuring no important appointments are missed.
